title: Eastman Smart 1400 Pure Sinewave Solar Inverter 1000VA/12V...
description: Eastman Smart 1400 1000VA/12V Pure Sinewave Solar Inverter is designed as an all‑in‑one solar, battery and grid solution for households and businesses looking to reduce electricity bills and enjoy reliable backup. The 1000VA pure sine wave output delivers clean, stable power that keeps sensitive electronics such as LED TVs, computers, routers and refrigerators running safely during power cuts. With a wide AC input range and battery‑friendly 18–20 A charging current, it works efficiently in Indian grid conditions and supports everyday loads without flicker or noise.What sets this PCU apart is its smart energy management and solar optimisation. Three selectable savings modes (Intelligent, Hybrid and Solar) allow users to decide when to draw from solar, battery or grid, so daytime loads can be run largely on solar and battery, while grid use is minimised. Zero Drop PWM solar charger topology eliminates series diodes to cut losses and heat, boosting charging efficiency to over 95% and ensuring that available solar power—up to 1300 W and 60 A solar current—is fully utilised. For safety and durability, the inverter includes PV reverse protection and double PV Voc protection, which safeguard the charger and panels from incorrect or excess voltage connections by triggering alarms and resuming normal charging once corrected. Combined with a 36‑month product warranty and 10‑year transformer warranty, Eastman Smart 1400 delivers a high‑value, long‑life solar backup solution for modern homes and offices.
